scope: Exploratory recheck of the original 24-parameter ring on the existing historical cohort; not an independent confirmation or a reproduction of the printed 18 percent.

selection_rules.best_fixed: One sigma/K minimizing mean exact KL over the analyzed cohort; descriptive selection on evaluation data.
selection_rules.oracle: A separate sigma/K minimizing exact target KL for each beta/seed; target-aware diagnostic, not an implementable training-only selection rule.
selection_rules.validation: Select separately for each beta/seed by mean negative log likelihood on 200 additional IID validation observations shared by all candidates; no exact KL used for this rule.

controls: MSE with the initialization chosen by parity
MSE independently selecting among its three distinct K-dependent initializations
resource_accounting: 12 distinct parity fits and 3 distinct MSE fits per beta/seed. Existing CLI executes 12 MSE entries; sigma leaves MSE unchanged. Validation selection uses 200 extra observations for each model family. Each fit receives 200 training draws and 600 updates. Candidate selection changes total search cost.
uncertainty: Descriptive paired Student-t 95 percent intervals; average repeated beta values within each of the ten seed IDs. Intervals are not corrected for retrospective setting selection and are not confirmatory claims.
stopping_rule: Complete the specified grid and retain every result. Do not add settings or replace seeds based on outcomes.
